plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Plan-driven autonomous dev loop: write-plan/execute-plan + tier-routed builders (builder/builder-light) with TDD enforcement + independent reviewer per task + stage-reviewer integration review, worktree-isolated parallel groups with a post-merge verify gate, destructive-command + revert-category + out-of-scope-write deny hooks, RESUME checkpoints (PreCompact flush), plus brainstorming/grill/docs/debugging/harden skills and repo self-audit.
